welcome.title: The annotation editor
welcome.text: Where a gel is read: its lanes, their bands and samples, the ladder's molecular weights, ready for densitometry. A short tour of the toolbar and the side panel; leave it at any time with <kbd>Esc</kbd>.

steps.title: Three views of one analysis
steps.text: Analysis: the analysis page, its status, lanes and samples. Annotate: this editor. Densitometry: where the bands are measured, greyed until the gel has a band. The arrow on the left goes back to the analysis.

steps.title: Select, pan, zoom
steps.text: Select (V) picks a lane or band to move, resize or edit; Pan (H) drags the gel. Next to them, zoom out and in (- +) and fit the gel to the window (0). The scroll wheel zooms at the cursor.

steps.title: Find the lanes with the wand
steps.text: The lane model finds the gel's lanes, then you review them on the gel: click a lane to keep or drop it, its tag to change its type, then accept them. It replaces the lanes already drawn, and their bands, so it asks first.

steps.title: Find the bands with the band model
steps.text: Once the lanes are saved, the model finds the bands of every lane in one pass, in your browser (Shift+Y); nothing is saved until you click Save all. It knows a band, not your protein: type the POI bands yourself.

steps.title: Draw lanes and bands by hand
steps.text: Lane: a rectangle (L), four corners for a tilted lane (Q) or a polygon (P). Band (B): drag a box inside a lane. Split (S) cuts in two a band the detector merged.

steps.title: MW calibration
steps.text: Once the ladder's lane is typed MW Ladder and has its bands, MW Calibration (C) ties the weights of its template to the bands' positions: the gel's bands then read in kDa. MW lines (M) shows them on the gel.

steps.title: The editor's panels
steps.text: Lane Editor (T): every lane in a table, its type, load and sample. Band Editor (E): the selected lane's bands. Adjust Image (A): the display only. Electropherogram (G): the selected lane's profile.

steps.title: How this gel is read
steps.text: At the top of this panel: what each band counts as for the gel's assay (the POI and its purity, HMWS and LMWS, HCP bands) and what to check while annotating; click a line for what to do. Under it, the properties of the lane or band you select.
